summary: Iter 152 — Firebase service-account key rotation validated. New key (project_id=populus-1f567, client_email=firebase-adminsdk-fbsvc@populus-1f567.iam.gserviceaccount.com) is loaded by the running backend via FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH=/app/backend/firebase-service-account.json. /api/auth/firebase-session with a bogus token returns HTTP 401 with detail 'Token Firebase non valido: Illegal Firebase custom token...' — this is a SDK-level rejection (not 503/500) proving Firebase Admin SDK initialized correctly with the new credentials. Missing/empty body returns 422 (Pydantic validation). Supervisor backend log (post last boot marker) contains ZERO occurrences of 'Firebase init failed', 'FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON parse failed' or 'Firebase not configured'. Regression: email/password login, signup (requires_verification path), anonymous session, google-session (bogus session → 4xx not 5xx), /api/feuds, /api/stories/feed, /api/notifications, admin gate (no token → 401/403, with X-Admin-Key populus-admin-42b8f3 → <500), retention endpoints correctly rejecting unauthenticated POSTs. Iter150/151 guarantees re-verified: no destructive-startup log entries, verify-email requires token / rejects garbage, resend-verification returns generic 200, package-lock.json absent. Total: 21 new (iter152) + 41 regression (iter149+iter150+iter151) = 62/62 PASS in 8.8s.
action_items: Optional (owner-only, still pending from iter149-151): consider migrating from FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH (file on disk) to FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON (env var) in production so the rotated service-account payload never lives in the container filesystem. _get_firebase_app() already prefers _JSON over _PATH when both are set — only the ops config needs to change.

Optional: purge git history of the previous firebase-service-account.json commit if it was ever checked in (the file is now in .gitignore per iter149 but the old key may still be reachable via `git log`).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1290-1331 — _get_firebase_app() dual-mode is idempotent (globals cache the initialized app) and correctly returns None on parse failure so /firebase-session gracefully degrades to 503 rather than crashing the whole route. Confirmed working with the rotated key on the file-path branch.

server.py:1338-1347 — 401 message includes the raw firebase-admin exception ('Token Firebase non valido: ...'). This leaks the SDK's internal error string to the client (e.g. 'Illegal Firebase custom token: Wrong number of segments'). Acceptable for a 4xx (helps client-side debugging), but consider truncating in production if you don't want to reveal SDK internals.

backend/.env:11-12 — FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH and FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID (populus-1f567) match the JSON payload. FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID is not read by _get_firebase_app() itself (firebase-admin infers it from the cert) — it's set only for reference/future use. No functional impact.

rca_of_issue: Not a bug this iteration. Main agent rotated the Firebase service-account key + shipped a new GoogleService-Info.plist. Testing agent validated the rotation by: (1) parsing the on-disk JSON to confirm project_id/client_email match the announced new values, (2) exercising /api/auth/firebase-session with a bogus token and confirming the response comes from the firebase-admin SDK verifier (401 with 'Token Firebase non valido: ...') rather than the pre-verifier guard (503 'Firebase non configurato'), (3) grep'ing the supervisor log after the last 'Started server process' boot marker for any 'Firebase init failed' / 'parse failed' entries — none found. Combined, these three signals prove the new key was accepted by firebase-admin at initialize_app() time. Regression suite confirms the rotation didn't disturb any other auth path or public read endpoint.
